t: This is The Turning Point, a sculpture by Alan Thornhill, the British artist who lived from 1921 to 2020. Thornhill's work began with pottery, and his long association with clay carried him into sculpture, both small and large. He also made portrait heads, paintings and drawings. His methods let him drop the usual internal armature and improvise as he went. So when you look at this piece, you're seeing the work of someone who shaped his forms freely, with a very practiced hand.
